project_type: MCP server (stdio) — a superset of Playwright MCP with a local on-device Laya decision engine for browser automation
build_system: npm + tsc. A pnpm-lock.yaml exists but package.json uses npm-style deps; use `npm install` and `npm run <script>`. tsconfig at tsconfig.json.
test_framework: vitest ^3 (test/*.test.ts). Tests drive REAL headless Playwright Chromium against local loopback HTML fixtures served by test/helpers/fixture-server.ts (startFixtureServer). Fixtures live in test/fixtures/*.html.
build_command: npm run build (tsc -p tsconfig.json). Typecheck-only: npm run typecheck.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run typecheck must be clean. 2) npm run test must pass (baseline: 138 passed, 2 skipped — the 2 skips are real-weights Autopilot gated on LAYA_MODEL_DIR and WebKit gated on inability to launch here). 3) npm run build must emit dist/. Overlay visuals are verified HEADLESS by taking Playwright screenshots and asserting overlay DOM nodes exist/are visible/pointer-events:none via page.evaluate/locators — NOT via a visible window.
snapshot_or_generated_files: benchmark/ artifacts (results.json, RESULTS.md, charts/*.svg) are generated by `npm run bench:compare` and checked in. This task does NOT need to regenerate them; do not touch benchmark artifacts unless a change alters measured behavior. dist/ is gitignored build output.
setup_instructions: npm install; npx playwright install chromium; (npx playwright install firefox for the pre-existing cross-browser smoke test). All already done in this sandbox: deps installed, chromium + firefox installed. NOTE: only chrome-headless-shell binary is present for chromium (headed full chromium is NOT installed and cannot render — headless LINUX with no display server).
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET, but HEADLESS LINUX WITH NO DISPLAY SERVER. A real headed/GUI window CANNOT render. Therefore the code MUST default to headed but auto-fallback to headless when a headed launch throws (no display), logging a warning to stderr, so it never hard-crashes in CI/sandbox yet opens a real window on a user's machine. ALL overlay verification is done headless via screenshots + DOM assertions. Do NOT introduce networkidle or slowMo. No Dockerfile in repo, so docker build is not applicable.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Conventions from README + code: Boundary Discipline (config parsed ONCE in src/config.ts and handed inward as typed config; no other module reads process.env for these settings). BrowserSession (src/browser.ts) is the SOLE Playwright boundary. Commit locally on a feature branch or leave working-tree changes; do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator publishes).
key_patterns: Env parsing helpers in config.ts: envBoolDefaultTrue (only "false" disables) and envBoolDefaultFalse (only "true" enables). Overlay DOM must be injected via context.addInitScript so it survives navigation/new pages (the existing one-shot highlight() via page.evaluate is WIPED on navigation). All overlay nodes: pointer-events:none + very high z-index so they never intercept clicks or alter page behavior. Brand accent purple #a855f7 on a dark HUD (agentLens palette). Tool handlers return ToolResult via textResult/imageResult (src/tools/shared.ts). Tests use BrowserSession directly + navigate.makeHandler + startFixtureServer; assert literal DOM/screenshot outcomes.
relevant_files: src/browser.ts — BrowserSession: SOLE Playwright boundary. Constructor `headless: options.headless ?? true` -> flip to `?? false`. launch() calls browserType.launch({headless, ...channel}) with no args/slowMo -> add try/catch headed->headless fallback logging to stderr. Owns highlight()/hideHighlight() (navigation-fragile one-shot) -> replace with overlay module injected via context.addInitScript in launch(). Mouse ops mouseMove/mouseClick/mouseDown/mouseUp/mouseDrag/mouseWheel are here. resolveRef() maps eN -> Locator.

src/config.ts — loadConfig(); headless default via envBoolDefaultTrue(env.LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS) -> switch to default-FALSE (headless only when LAYA_BROWSER_HEADLESS==="true") using envBoolDefaultFalse. Add overlay config: LayaBrowserConfig fields + ConfigOverrides + env parsing for LAYA_BROWSER_OVERLAY (on/off/auto, default on-in-headed off-in-headless), typing effect (default OFF), WAIT countdown (default OFF), brand accent (#a855f7). DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=0.6, DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS=15, DEFAULT_VIEWPORT=1280x800.

src/overlay.ts — NEW self-contained overlay module owned by BrowserSession. Injected via addInitScript. Typed server-side API: setStatus/moveCursor/spotlight/ripple/toast/log/progress/setState(thinking|acting|success|error|uncertain)/countdown. Implements Tiers 1-4 (banner, cursor, ripple, spotlight, popover/caption, HUD step N/max + thinking/acting, progress bar, typing effect opt-in, scroll indicator, toasts, success/error/uncertainty coloring, WAIT countdown opt-in, collapsible activity-log panel, Esc-to-release hint, idle heartbeat pulse, debug 'what agent sees' element outlines reusing data-laya-ref).

src/autopilot/loop.ts — runGoal() loop; execute() is 'the ONLY function in the loop that performs Playwright IO' — the switch over CLICK/TYPE_TEXT/SELECT/HOVER/FILL_FORM/PRESS_KEY/NAVIGATE_BACK/SCROLL_DOWN/WAIT/SCREENSHOT/VERIFY/DONE/BLOCKED. This is where per-step overlay narration hooks in (progress step N/maxSteps, thinking-vs-acting state, cursor move to target, spotlight, action popover/caption, uncertainty amber when escalating, WAIT countdown, activity-log append). WAIT uses page.waitForTimeout(options.waitMs), default 500 (DEFAULT_WAIT_MS) — make configurable/lower. Thread overlay from session into loop.

src/snapshot.ts — capture()/domWalk: isVisible() calls BOTH getComputedStyle(el) AND getBoundingClientRect() per element (double forced reflow) + reads document.body.innerText. Dominant repeated latency cost (runs after nearly every action + every autopilot step). Speed work: reduce the double-reflow / add a lighter capture mode.
src/tools/shared.ts — snapshotResult(ctx, header) calls capture(page); invoked by ~17 mutating tools. Consider lighter/opt-out post-action snapshot via config.

src/tools/devtools.ts — browser_highlight/browser_hide_highlight backed by BrowserSession.highlight()/hideHighlight(); if those are re-backed by the overlay's spotlight, keep the tool contract working.
src/index.ts — main(): loadConfig() then createServer({engine, config}). Update env doc comment.
src/server.ts — createServer builds BrowserSessionOptions from config (engine/headless/viewport/channel). Thread overlay config into the session and into run_goal context if needed.
test/helpers/fixture-server.ts — startFixtureServer(); test/fixtures/*.html (login.html, search-form.html, multi-field-form.html, nav-a.html/nav-b.html, list.html etc.).
test/devtools-tools.test.ts, test/assist.test.ts, test/config.test.ts — patterns for writing real headless tests + config parsing tests.
directory_structure: src/ (browser.ts, config.ts, snapshot.ts, server.ts, index.ts, state-builder.ts, safety.ts, types.ts, registry.ts); src/autopilot/ (loop.ts, policy.ts, escalation.ts); src/laya/ (engine.ts, goal.ts, index.ts, stub.ts); src/tools/ (one file per tool + shared.ts, index.ts, registry.ts, fill.ts). test/ (*.test.ts + helpers/ + fixtures/). benchmark/ (generated artifacts). docs/PLAN.md. README.md is the authoritative behavior doc + config table.
